canon_ref.note: When she wakes, healed; the same day or the next. He says she needs several days to recover before she goes.

b1.teriarch_lays_a_geas_on_ryoka.summary: A spell makes Ryoka obey and tell only truth. Teriarch learns she refuses to level, not that she is the Ryoka Magnolia named. He binds her by geas to carry a letter and ring to Az'kerash, alive in the Blood Fields, pays in gold, a speed potion and a fire wand, and teleports her to Celum.
